what: package.aide-memory.json is MISSING `chalk` and `fast-glob` as dependencies, but both are imported at runtime: chalk throughout src/cli/commands/memory/*.ts, fast-glob in src/memory/scopes.ts. The live aide-memory@0.1.1 npm package likely crashes on a clean install where the user's node_modules doesn't transitively provide them. Bun compile bundles both into the binary, so this isn't a binary-migration blocker, but it IS a live bug in the current Node-distribution path. Fix: add `"chalk": "^4.1.2"` and `"fast-glob": "^3.3.3"` to `package.aide-memory.json` dependencies before the next publish.
why: Discovered during Phase 1 dep audit. Important for anyone maintaining the npm publish path independent of the binary migration — could be affecting real users on 0.1.1.
